desc: Three hand-bells hang in the nave. Ring them low, middle, high.
Every birch gossips. One tells the truth — it's the one that says it doesn't know.
An Owlcrow asks a riddle with three answers to pick from.
Put the three song scraps in the right order.
Your reflection in the third mirror moves first. Step through it.
Follow your own glowing footsteps down the Quiet Stair. Stray and they fade (no penalty).
Ninety-nine chairs. One has your name.
